# Iron Doggy

> Iron Doggy™ offers innovative hands-free dog leashes designed for runners and hikers who want to keep their hands free while exercising with their dogs.

Founded by Denver-based runners, Iron Doggy specializes in hands-free leash systems including the Runner's Choice and SideKick models, along with complementary running accessories. The brand has earned recognition from major media outlets including Triathlete Magazine and the Today Show.

## Key Topics

- Runner's Choice Hands-Free Dog Leash
- SideKick Hands-Free Dog Leash

- [Runner's Choice by Iron Doggy | Best Dog Leash Running](https://irondoggy.com/products/runners-choice-hands-free-leash): Product page for original Runner's Choice hands-free dog leash

- [Extra Iron Doggy Leash - Iron Doggy™](https://irondoggy.com/products/extra-leash): Replacement leash for connecting multiple dogs to single Iron Doggy belt
